# Another Dungeon: reward details

Source: anothereden.wiki, page "Another Dungeon" (saved 2026-11-27, revision 342027), the "Badge
Rewards", "Story Character Light/Shadow Points" and "Otherlands" parts. Facts only; no game art.
The reward thresholds and the rules for story characters are in
[another-dungeon.md](another-dungeon.md); every dungeon's tomes in
[another-dungeon-list.md](another-dungeon-list.md).

## Badges per reward line

A dungeon's completion rewards (see the thresholds in [another-dungeon.md](another-dungeon.md))
are lines 1 to 3. For each line the page gives the stats a badge's main stat can be; the sub
stat is any other stat or none. Stats: PWR power, END endurance, INT intelligence, SPR spirit,
SPD speed, LCK luck. The cells are copied from the page's own wording (a slash separates
the stats a main stat can be, "?" is a gap the page shows).

| Dungeon | Line 1 | Line 2 | Line 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sapient Complex: Midnight | PWR / END | INT / SPR | SPD / LCK |
| Forest of Forgetfulness | SPD / LCK | END / SPR | INT / SPR |
| Hanging Garden | PWR / END | INT / SPR | SPD / LCK |

Notes: Toto Theater World's lines read "Stat+" and "Stat Halved" (a badge with one stat raised and
one halved). Transitory Time Space lines give EXP+ badges; Ruins of Rucyana's give status
resistance and EXP+ badges. The page repeats some rows (Transitory Time Space, Dust City, Isle
of Gospel, Land of Ro, Tower of Selection, The Tower Argentauri); here each is listed once.

## Story characters' Light/Shadow, by dungeon

A story character in the party can gain 1 Light or Shadow point in their dungeons (chances and
rules: [another-dungeon.md](another-dungeon.md#story-characters-lightshadow)). The page shows
which of the two with an icon beside the character. All dungeon names match
[the list](another-dungeon-list.md). The same pairs, per dungeon, are in the list's last-but-one
column.

79 character and dungeon pairs. Also on the page: Strawboy gains Light without keys, through the
Straw Dummy Cultivation (a game feature, not a dungeon); and every Free Character and Ramiu
can gain from Toto Theater World. Only a few characters use Light/Shadow in their skills
(the page names Aldo, Feinne, Glenn, Guildna, Serge, Spirika and their alternate styles).
Stellar Awakening needs 15 points at least for the skill and ability nodes, and 80 for the
full board and the 4th skill slot.

## Otherlands gear

Each region's drops craft and upgrade special gear: Hard gives armor materials, Very Hard
weapon materials. Version = when the region came out.

| Region | Version | Weapons | Armor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Otherlands: Baruoki Region | 1.3.5 | Delos Xiphos, Crescent Shadow, Hecate's Shadow | Lux Gauntlets, Lux Necklace, Lux Ring |
| Otherlands: Ratle Region | 1.4.2 | Ulcanactos, Red Spider Lily, Bulk Faust, Prometerium | Hertz Bangle, Hertz Gauntlets, Hertz Necklace, Hertz Ring |
| Otherlands: Elzion Region | 1.6.1 | Oracle's Fury, Aceto Vita, Grati Aegis | Mechi-Bangle, Mechi-Ring, Mechi-Band |
